B.span:
जो मल से अतीत है,
जगत् के कल्याण में प्रवृत्त उस शांत
B.explanation: These attributes describe the practitioners/gentle ones in the Tibetan, but the translation incorrectly modifies 'प्रज्ञापारमिता' (perfection of wisdom).
The Tibetan 'བདག་' refers to the 'self' (atman) or oneself, not the first-person speaker 'I' (मैं).

A.explanation: Omits the translation of 'ཐམས་ཅད་' (all/sarva), rendering it 'path-knowledge' instead of 'knowledge of all paths'.

B.explanation: Omits 'ཆོས་' (dharmas) from the compound 'ཡོན་ཏན་ཆོས་' (qualities and dharmas).
The Tibetan 'སེམས་པ་' specifies 'cetanā' (volition/चेतना), not the general aggregate of formations 'saṃskāra' (संस्कार).
The Tibetan stanza ends with 'དང་' (and), linking it to the next stanza; a full stop incorrectly leaves the relative clause dangling.

A.span: यदि मैं जिन की प्रज्ञा की चर्या करूँ, और दुःख से स्पृष्ट अनेक कोटि-नियुत सत्त्वों को मुक्त करने का विचार करूँ, सत्त्व-संज्ञा की परिकल्पना करने वाला जो बोधिसत्त्व है,
A.explanation: The conditional clause lacks a proper main clause, making the sentence grammatically disjointed and difficult to parse.
The candidate translates 'empty-handed' but omits the specific Tibetan term 'zong zad' meaning 'goods/capital exhausted'.

A.span: जानना चाहिए कि, यद्यपि नायकों द्वारा उसे साक्षात् व्याकृत नहीं किया गया है, फिर भी "मैं शीघ्र ही बुद्ध-बोधि का स्पर्श करूँगा।"
A.explanation: The first-person quote lacks an introductory verb like 'he thinks', causing an awkward grammatical shift after 'should know that'.

B.span: परम बोधि में सम्यक् प्रविष्ट हुए लोगों को, जिनों की इस प्रज्ञापारमिता का श्रवण करने वाला जानना चाहिए;
B.explanation: The syntax incorrectly swaps subject and object, falsely implying the hearer should know the people entered into supreme bodhi.
The candidate awkwardly repeats the same word to translate two distinct Tibetan terms, creating unnecessary redundancy.
The candidate omits the translation of 'yang' (also), which is present in the source text.

B.span: वह मार्ग में नष्ट नहीं होता, और नष्ट हुए बिना
B.explanation: The candidate blindly translates a typo in the Tibetan source, failing to use commentaries to correct it, resulting in a redundant and incorrect rendering.

B.span: बोधि के स्कन्धों में आसक्त होकर श्रेष्ठ का आग्रह मत करो
B.explanation: The candidate mistranslates the syntax, creating 'skandhas of bodhi' and failing to recognize bodhi as the object of holding as supreme.

A.explanation: The candidate translates 'alpotsuka' literally as 'worried less', which contextually misrepresents the Buddha's disinclination to teach.

B.explanation: The candidate adds an explanatory gloss directly into the translation, which is not present in the source text.
